findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: When a user requests a document belonging to another tenant, returning `true` unconditionally bypasses the previous `userTenant === documentTenant` authorization check and permits cross-tenant data access.

findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation in document read checks
findings.body:
Returning true unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging to any tenant, whereas the previous implementation required the user and document tenants to match. This is a direct authorization bypass and risks cross-tenant data disclosure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
